tools.description: Fetches an agent's head metadata (status, counts, timestamps, tools, attached knowledge base). Without `version_number` it returns no guidelines — call `moveo_get_agent_guidelines` for the playbook. Pass `version_number: 0` for the editable draft or a positive integer for a published snapshot (both include guidelines). Published snapshots are identified by `agent_parent_id` + `version`. For workflows, `moveo_list_agent_workflows`; for insights, `moveo_list_agent_insights`.

version_number.description: `0` = editable draft; a positive integer = published snapshot. Omit for head metadata only.

tools.name: moveo_get_agent
tools.title: Get Agent

tools.description: Creates a new agent as an editable draft (version 0), seeded with the language base template. Pass `guidelines` to apply the playbook in the same call (same fields and deep-merge as `moveo_update_agent_guidelines`) and `train: true` to queue training; if a later step fails the draft is deleted again. Drafts are not served until `moveo_publish_agent`. `language` is permanent. Valid `language` / `agent_type` / `tools` values: resources `moveo://schemas/agent-languages`, `agent-types`, `agent-tools`.

guidelines.description: Initial guidelines (the natural-language playbook), deep-merged onto the template after the draft exists — the fields moveo_update_agent_guidelines accepts.

custom_guidelines.description: Deprecated. Only an empty array is accepted, which clears the legacy block. Fold its content into `custom_instructions` in the same call, or the guidance is lost.

objections.description: Either a list of `{message, response}` pairs (max 50, one per objection) or one free-text block. Send the list on an agent that already stores one; replacing it with a string discards the pairs.

tone_of_voice.description: Tone of voice: -1 = formal, 0 = neutral (default), 1 = friendly, 2 = casual.

language.description: BCP-47-style tag. See moveo://schemas/agent-languages. Locked after create.

tools.description: Built-in capabilities. See moveo://schemas/agent-tools. Defaults to all.

train.description: Queue a full training run once the draft (and guidelines) exist. Poll moveo_get_agent until `status` is `available`.

tools.name: moveo_create_agent
tools.title: Create Agent

tools.description: Patches an agent's top-level fields: name, description, language_model_id, knowledge_base_id, agent_type, tools, starting_node_id (at least one required). `language` is immutable. May trigger retraining when `tools` changes; other fields (`name`, `description`, `language_model_id`, `knowledge_base_id`, `agent_type`) update without retraining. Do NOT use for guidelines (overview/features/objections/custom_instructions/channel_guidelines/etc.) — use `moveo_update_agent_guidelines` which deep-merges single fields. Valid `agent_type`/`tools` values are catalogued in resources `moveo://schemas/agent-types` and `moveo://schemas/agent-tools`.

starting_node_id.description: Node the session starts on, instead of waiting for a first user message. Must be a node_id that exists in one of this agent's workflows (see moveo_get_agent_workflow). null clears it.

tools.name: moveo_update_agent
tools.title: Update Agent

tools.description: Patches the agent's guidelines (the natural-language playbook). Deep-merges — pass only the fields to change. Use this for goal/overview/features/loyalty/objections/custom_instructions/response_size/tone_of_voice/factuality_sensitivity/support_handover/reminders/channel_guidelines. Do NOT use for top-level fields (name, language_model_id, knowledge_base_id, agent_type, tools) — use `moveo_update_agent` instead. `channel_guidelines` is `{chat, email, voice}`; pass a channel as null to clear it. Only draft agents (version 0) accept edits; publish to roll forward. Read the current values with `moveo_get_agent_guidelines`. This text becomes the agent's runtime prompt — read `moveo://schemas/guideline-authoring` before writing it.

custom_guidelines.description: Deprecated. Only an empty array is accepted, which clears the legacy block. Fold its content into `custom_instructions` in the same call, or the guidance is lost.

objections.description: Either a list of `{message, response}` pairs (max 50, one per objection) or one free-text block. Send the list on an agent that already stores one; replacing it with a string discards the pairs.

tone_of_voice.description: Tone of voice: -1 = formal, 0 = neutral (default), 1 = friendly, 2 = casual.

tools.name: moveo_update_agent_guidelines
tools.title: Update Agent Guidelines

tools.description: Queues a full retrain of the agent. Idempotent — re-queues are coalesced server-side. Returns immediately; poll `moveo_get_agent` until `status` is `available` (it flips to `training` while in-flight, then back to `available` when the new model is active; `last_trained` advances too). Editing intents, dialogs, guidelines, tools, or `confidence_threshold` already triggers retraining server-side, so reach for this tool only when you need to force a retrain explicitly.
tools.name: moveo_train_agent
tools.title: Train Agent

tools.description: Lists live sessions currently routed to this agent. Only **active** sessions are returned (closed / archived ones do not appear). Use this to discover a `session_id` for `moveo_get_session_transcript` when an end user reports a problem without giving you the id directly. `limit` caps the result set (default 50, max 200). Not paginated: `has_more` is always false and `total` is the page length — raise `limit` instead.

limit.description: Max sessions to return (default 50, max 200).

tools.name: moveo_list_agent_live_sessions

tools.description: Low-level NLC probe: returns ranked intent hypotheses for a single utterance against the agent's currently active classifier model. Not the normal entry point — the runtime LLM planner picks intents during a real conversation. Reach for this only when you need to inspect raw classifier output for an authoring decision. Use `moveo_send_test_message` for end-to-end behaviour. Needs a trained agent. An empty classifier answers `CLASSIFIER-NO-EXPRESSIONS` when the agent has no intents (guidelines-only — not a fault), `CLASSIFIER-MODEL-STALE` when it does (a training fault).
tools.name: moveo_classify_utterance
tools.title: Classify Utterance

tools.description: Lists all published versions of an agent, plus the draft (version 0). Each entry includes version number, description, status and timestamps, never the guidelines; read one version with `moveo_get_agent(version_number)` for those. Pass `q` to text-search across name and description.

limit.description: Page size (max 100). Default 20. Raise it only when the user explicitly asks for many results — larger pages bloat the agent context.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor copied from the previous page's `next_cursor`; omit for the first page.

tools.name: moveo_list_agent_versions

has_more.description: True when another page exists — pass next_cursor to fetch it.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

total.description: Total matching rows when the orchestrator reports one; null when it does not.

tools.title: List Agent Versions

tools.description: Returns what changed between two agent versions, with the changed values. Pass `0` for the current draft or a positive integer for a published version; compare draft vs published with `(from_version: 0, to_version: <published>)`. Read `diff.summary` first to decide whether you need the body, then re-call with `path` to drill into one subtree. A credential change reports its path only, never the value. Invalid version pairs return 400.

from_version.description: `0` = current draft; a positive integer = a published version.

limit.description: Max entries in `changes` (default 50). `summary` stays complete regardless.

path.description: Narrows the diff to one subtree and raises the per-field text budget, so you can read a change the capped response summarized. Copy a `path` exactly as a `changes` entry returned it, escaping and all — for example `guidelines/custom_instructions` or `dialogs/Sales~1EU`.

to_version.description: `0` = current draft; a positive integer = a published version.

tools.name: moveo_diff_agent_versions
tools.title: Diff Agent Versions

tools.description: Publishes the current draft as a new immutable version and returns the version record; training and rule swapping happen synchronously — usually ~10s, up to 30s, so wait rather than retry. Publish only when training is idle — `moveo_get_agent` must report `status: 'available'`, not `training`, or you publish a half-trained draft. If the version ends `status: 'failed'`: fix the content, wait for idle training, publish again or roll back. Preview with `moveo_diff_agent_versions({from_version: <prev_published>, to_version: 0})`; revert with `moveo_rollback_agent_to_version`.

force.description: Bypass active-session/safety guards that would otherwise block publishing. Prefer resolving live sessions deliberately.

replace_version.description: Overwrite this existing published version number instead of appending a new one. Omit/null to append.

tools.name: moveo_publish_agent
tools.title: Publish Agent

tools.description: Sends a message to an agent in test mode and returns the reply plus a compact diagnosis (intent and confidence, nodes fired, webhook errors, tools invoked). Requires a trained agent (`moveo_get_agent`: `last_trained` non-null, `status` `available`). Do NOT use for intent classification only — use `moveo_classify_utterance`. A live transcript carries no debug data, so diagnose a test from this reply. Omit `session_id` to start a conversation; pass the returned one to continue it.

context.description: Seed context variables for the session (max 100 top-level keys), the way a real channel would — e.g. {"customer_name": "Ana", "amount_due": 240.5}. Required to exercise any node whose conditions or requisites read context; without it a realistic flow falls through to the generic path. Send it on the first call of a session only: context survives between turns on the same session_id, so a webhook output or a set_variables action is visible to the next call. A reply that renders %UNKNOWN% means the text referenced a variable that was never set — check the spelling and the {{$var}} braces before assuming the value was lost.

include_debug.description: Adds a `debug` block per reply — the full `output.debug` tree (`nodes_stack`, `steps[]` with `type`/`sub_type` as names, `intent_match_confidence` vs `intent_match_threshold`, `webhook_error`, `context_changes`, `duration`), `request_code`/`response_code` as names, `standalone_question`, `collection` (knowledge-base retrieval), `tools_invoked`, `logs`. A synthesis answer has no steps. Cannot be fetched later — pass true before sending when diagnosing.

session_id.description: Reuse a session_id returned by a previous call to continue a conversation. Omit to start a fresh session — the gateway mints a UUID for you.

tools.name: moveo_send_test_message
tools.title: Send Test Message

tools.description: Restores a published version as the new draft. The current draft is overwritten. Use moveo_diff_agent_versions first to confirm what will change. Triggers retraining; poll moveo_get_agent until status is available.

version_number.description: Published version number to restore as the new draft (≥ 1).

tools.name: moveo_rollback_agent_to_version
tools.title: Rollback Agent To Version

tools.description: Deletes an agent and all its versions, intents, dialogs, webhooks, and MCP attachments. Cannot be undone. Refuses by default if attached to any environment or with webhooks/MCP servers/insights/simulations — detach/clean first, or pass `force=true`. Always blocked when the agent has run traffic in the last 7 days (regardless of `force`); use the dashboard for those.

force.description: Bypass the attachment/webhook/MCP/insight refusal. The 7-day activity guard still always applies.

tools.name: moveo_delete_agent
tools.title: Delete Agent

tools.description: LLM-as-judge validation for any subset of the agent's authoring guideline fields. Advisory only — nothing is persisted. Pass the field(s) you just edited (or are about to save) and receive a verdict + recommendation. Mirrors the fields accepted by `moveo_update_agent_guidelines`, plus **`prev_recommendation`** (the previous run's output) for anti-nag / deduplication across iterations. At least one field besides `agent_id` is required.

objections.description: Either a list of `{message, response}` pairs (max 50, one per objection) or one free-text block. Send the list on an agent that already stores one; replacing it with a string discards the pairs.

tools.name: moveo_validate_agent_guidelines
tools.title: Validate Agent Guidelines

tools.description: Lists references from other dialogs on the same agent that point at any node inside the given dialog (via `trigger_node_id`). Useful as a **precheck before delete** — when references exist, deleting the dialog will fail with `NODE_STILL_REFERENCED`. The returned `references` array names each referring dialog plus the specific `trigger_node_id` so you can update / remove the references before retrying.
tools.name: moveo_get_dialog_references
tools.title: Get Dialog References

tools.description: Clones a **draft** agent (version 0) into a new draft. The source agent must not have been published yet (orchestrator returns 400 with `brain_version_cannot_be_modified` if it has). When `name` is omitted, the orchestrator appends ` (2)` to the source name (truncated so the result fits the 32-char limit). Returns the new draft agent. To clone a published agent, first call `moveo_rollback_agent_to_version` against its draft, then clone.
tools.name: moveo_clone_agent
tools.title: Clone Agent

tools.description: Reads the agent's guidelines — the natural-language playbook (goal, overview, features, loyalty, objections, custom_instructions, response_size, tone_of_voice, factuality_sensitivity, support_handover, reminders, channel_guidelines). Read twin of `moveo_update_agent_guidelines`: read here, patch there. An older agent may also carry `custom_guidelines`, a deprecated block still rendered into its prompt; read it as part of the playbook and see `moveo://schemas/guideline-authoring` to retire it. For the guidelines of a published version use `moveo_get_agent` with `version_number`.

tools.title: Get Agent Guidelines

Each entry returns a lite intent list (names only), `intent_count`, `has_intents` (false when the workflow has no intents referenced — useful for spotting stubs), and a node-tree summary. Pass `q` to text-search across name and description. Rows are compact — no node tree; use `moveo_get_agent_workflow` for full intent payloads and the node tree.

tools.title: List Agent Workflows

tools.description: Fetches a single workflow on an agent — the full dialog plus the intents its nodes reference. `workflow_id` is the dialog id. Each intent carries `expression_count`, never the expressions: they are training data, they dominate the payload, and a workflow read is about the dialog. For the phrases themselves read the `resource_link` this returns, or `moveo_get_agent_intent` for one intent. HTML entities in the dialog are decoded on read, as the runtime renders them; write plain text. Read-only.
tools.name: moveo_get_agent_workflow
tools.title: Get Agent Workflow

tools.description: Creates a workflow: posts the listed intents, then the dialog whose nodes reference them, rolling the intents back if the dialog fails. Triggers retraining — poll `moveo_get_agent` until `status` is `available`. Node shapes and the cross-field rules are in resource `moveo://schemas/workflow-node-types`; the patterns and one worked example per type are in `moveo://guides/workflow-authoring` — load both before composing `nodes`.

group.description: Free-text label that groups related intents and workflows in the dashboard tree. Not a knowledge base.

intents.description: Only NEW intents — a slug that already exists fails the call; omit it, nodes may still reference it by name. Never include the platform-managed `offtopics` intent.

group.description: Free-text label that groups related intents and workflows in the dashboard tree. Not a knowledge base.

nodes.description: Discriminated union on `type` (`intent` / `event` / `unknown`) — the full grammar is in resource `moveo://schemas/workflow-node-types`, which you must read before composing this. `node_id` must be unique within the dialog; `parent_id`, when set, names another `node_id`, never its own.

tools.name: moveo_create_agent_workflow
tools.title: Create Agent Workflow

tools.description: Patches a workflow in fixed order: (1) create intents, (2) update intents (rename via `new_intent`), (3) patch the dialog, (4) delete intents. Fail-fast — on error later steps are skipped; call `moveo_get_agent_workflow` to inspect and retry. Triggers retraining. Send only what you are changing: a patch stripped to nothing fails rather than reporting a change it did not make, and ignored field names come back in `_meta.ignored_keys`.

dialog.description: Every field is independent: `{ name }` alone renames the workflow and leaves the node tree alone. Set `group` to move it between dashboard groups.

group.description: Free-text label that groups related intents and workflows in the dashboard tree. Not a knowledge base.

nodes.description: Omit to leave the node tree untouched — a name/description/group-only patch is valid. When present, replaces every node wholesale, no merge: a field you omit from a node is dropped. Same grammar as create: read `moveo://schemas/workflow-node-types` first.

group.description: Free-text label that groups related intents and workflows in the dashboard tree. Not a knowledge base.
Free-text label that groups related intents and workflows in the dashboard tree. Not a knowledge base.

tools.title: List Agent Webhooks

tools.description: Fetches a single webhook by id. Secrets never come back: `token` collapses to `token_set`, `headers` to `[{name, value_set}]` — names visible, values not. To change one header you must resend the whole `headers` array with its values; the masked read tells you which names to resend. See `moveo_list_agent_webhooks` for the `enabled` vs MCP `is_active` naming note.
tools.name: moveo_get_agent_webhook
tools.title: Get Agent Webhook

tools.description: Creates an outbound webhook on an agent. The agent calls this URL during conversations (e.g. lookup-order, create-ticket). Choose `type=action` for tool-calling style hooks; pre/post/first/log run automatically at conversation lifecycle points.
tools.name: moveo_create_agent_webhook
tools.title: Create Agent Webhook

tools.description: Patches a webhook. Pass any subset of name, url, token, headers, type, fail_on_error, enabled — at least one is required. `headers` replaces the whole array rather than merging, so resend every header you want to keep; a read returns the names (`[{name, value_set}]`) but never the values, which you must supply again.

tools.description: Sends a synthetic test request to a real outbound webhook URL and returns the response (openWorld). Use after edits to verify connectivity before training. Pass `test_parameters` to control the body — without it the runner sends fixed placeholder data, which any endpoint expecting real domain fields rejects. The reply carries the outcome only (`responses`, `context`, `error`, `duration`); it does not echo the request body. Do NOT use for an LLM-extracted analytics insight — use `moveo_test_agent_insight`.

test_parameters.description: Overrides for the synthetic request body. Omit to send the runner defaults. When present, `business_closed`, `lang`, `channel` and `trigger.text` are all required upstream, and `context` / `trigger` replace the generated ones rather than merging.

tools.description:
Deletes a webhook from an agent. The agent stops being able to call this URL during conversations. Cannot be undone — to disable temporarily without deleting, use `moveo_update_agent_webhook({enabled: false})`.

**A referenced webhook cannot be deleted.** A database guard rejects the delete with a `DB_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION` error naming the blocking workflow when any dialog still points at this `webhook_id` — either from a `webhook` action or from an auth sub-agent step's `pre_enter_webhook_id`. Remove those references with `moveo_update_agent_workflow` (or delete the workflow) and retry.

tools.description: Creates a simulation (test case) for an agent. `scenario` describes user behavior; `pass_criteria` is the natural-language rule the LLM evaluator uses to grade pass/fail. Set `channel` to run as a real provider and `starting_context` to seed who the caller is before turn one. MCP creates manual-run simulations only; recurring schedules live in the dashboard.

category.description: Grouping label for `moveo_run_simulation({filter_category})`. Stored lowercased. Pass `null`, never an empty string, to leave the simulation uncategorized.

channel.description: Provider the simulated session runs as, which the agent reads as `sys-channel`. `null` runs as the synthetic `test` channel. Setting it also fixes `channel_type`.

channel_type.description: Coarse channel tier, `chat` when neither this nor `channel` is set. Derived from `channel` when one is set, so pass it alone only for a channel-less simulation or a multi-channel provider (custom, front, zendesk, zendesk_support, sunco). Passing it beside any other provider is an override the orchestrator refuses, even when it agrees with the tier.

max_turns.description: Max conversation turns the simulation runs before stopping (1–100, default 10).

starting_context.description: Session context seeded before the first turn, merged over the synthetic visitor. Nest values under the usual top-level keys — `{"user": {"display_name": "Maria"}}`, never `{"user.display_name": "Maria"}`. Use it to reproduce a caller the agent already knows. At most 100 top-level keys and 32768 bytes serialized.

tools.description: Triggers a manual simulation run. **Billable per simulation** — use `moveo_send_test_message` for a free single-turn check. Put every simulation you want to check in one run: they execute in parallel under one `run_id`. Pass `simulation_ids` for a subset, OR `filter_category` for a category, OR neither for all (mutually exclusive). Returns `run_id` at once; check `moveo_get_simulation_run`, then `moveo_get_simulation_evaluation` for verdicts. The agent must have trained once. Schedules and cancellation are dashboard-only.

tools.title: Get Knowledge Base

tools.description: Runs a **retrieval preview** against an indexed knowledge base (same neural pipeline agents use for RAG). Takes `{ query, limit?, include_draft?, mode? }`. `limit` defaults to 5 server-side, max 20. `include_draft: true` also searches unpublished fragments. `mode: "keyword"` uses Postgres trigram match (query must be ≥4 chars); default `"semantic"` runs the neural retrieval pipeline. Returns ranked `documents`; `total` is the page length, not the corpus hit count, and `has_more` is always false.
tools.name: moveo_search_knowledge_base
tools.title: Search Knowledge Base

tools.description: Promotes draft documents to live so production conversations can retrieve them (until published, only `moveo_send_test_message` sees them). Docs must be `available` first — poll `moveo_get_document`. The agent also needs this KB attached and the `search_knowledge_base` tool enabled. Pass exactly one of `include_all: true` or `include_document_ids: [...]`. `exclude_document_ids` and `datasource_types` further narrow the set.

Mirrors `moveo_describe_integration_config` for integrations. Also available as resources `moveo://schemas/datasource-config` and `moveo://schemas/datasource-config/{type}` (same body).

tools.description: Creates a datasource inside a knowledge base. Supported via MCP: `website` (crawl URLs), `faq` (Q&A content), `files` (manual uploads). External sources (zendesk_kb, intercom_kb, …) need OAuth — use the dashboard. Call **`moveo_describe_datasource_config`** first to learn the per-type config shape. `website` requires `config` (at least one of seed_urls/single_urls/sitemap_urls) at create. `faq`/`files` take no config — create, then add content with `moveo_upload_document` and poll `moveo_get_document`. Once docs reach `available`, call `moveo_publish_knowledge_base` so production sees them (drafts are test-only).

- `faq` / `files` datasources: upload content via `moveo_upload_document` instead of patching config.

config.description: Partial PATCH: merged key by key onto the current config, nested blocks included (one `tts_elevenlabs` field can change alone), so nothing has to be re-sent. Arrays and scalars replace wholesale.

tools.description: STT/TTS provider catalog for `web_voice`: providers, models and voice ids. Provider ids and model ids are what the config blocks accept. May briefly 503 on cold start — retry with backoff. Resource `moveo://snapshots/voice-providers` is the same catalog without voices.

kind.description: Only speech-to-text or only text-to-speech providers.

language.description: ISO code; keeps models whose `languages` include it and voices whose `language` equals it. A regional code ("pt-br") falls back to its primary subtag ("pt") when nothing matches exactly. MiniMax voices carry no language and are always kept.

q.description: Case-insensitive literal substring on voice name.

voices_limit.description: Max voices per provider after filtering.

Pair with `moveo_list_voice_providers` for the full provider/model/voice_id catalog and `moveo_describe_integration_config` for the web_voice config schema. tools.description: Fetches a session transcript, with a `turn_index` per entry. `author_type` is `user`, `brain` (the AI), `agent` (a human operator after handover), or `system`. A closed session is read from the archive for 189 days; `source` says `live`, `analytics` or `simulation`. Pass `include_debug` to see why the agent answered: each archived agent reply then carries `request_id`, `context` and `debug` (steps, tool calls). Past 20000 characters the tool returns a summary plus a ResourceLink.

environment_id.description: Checks the session belongs to this environment; omit to look it up by id.

include_debug.description: Adds the debug trace to each agent reply. Archived sessions only; a live one has none.
